text: dsh-plugin-files-download 为 DSH Web 文件树的文件行添加下载链接，目录行没有按钮。点击后，Host 路由按 1 MiB 窗口流式读取当前会话工作区文件，并让浏览器按原文件名保存。浏览器负责下载进度与取消。插件提供中英文按钮标签；需要 Node.js 22 以上，以及声明 sidebar.right.files.row.actions 座位的文件树。代码不需要 API key 或第三方服务。

dsh-plugin-files-download adds download links to DSH Web file rows. The Host streams session workspace files in 1 MiB windows for the browser to save under the original name. Requires Node.js 22+ and the sidebar.right.files.row.actions seat. No API key or external service is required.
想给 DSH Web 文件树里的文件加一个点一下就能保存的下载入口。
DSH 的文件面板能直接把工作区里的单个文件下载到本地吗？
I want a one-click way to save a file from the DSH Web workspace file list.
dsh-plugin-files-download 的功能「文件行下载」：在 DSH Web 文件树每个文件行显示下载链接，目录行不显示。点击链接会请求 Host 下载路由，浏览器按文件名保存文件。
dsh-plugin-files-download 的功能「分段流式传输」：Host 路由按 1 MiB 窗口读取文件并逐段写入响应流；浏览器停止接收时可随请求取消读取，适用于较大的单个文件。

dsh-plugin-files-download README · dsh-plugin-files-download：Give every file row of the [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web GUI's file tree a download button. One click saves the file under its own name, streamed from the Host — no size cap, nothing buffered in the page.

**中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。**

dsh-plugin-files-download README · What it adds：| Half | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers `GET\|HEAD /api/workspace-file.download?sessionId=…&path=…` inside the Connection authentication fence. Resolves the Session's workspace root the way the Remote lookups do, `stat`s the file to reject a missing path / directory / symlink, then streams the bytes in 1 MiB windows through `ctx.workspaceFiles` with `content-disposition: attachment` and the file's own name. |
| Browser | `lib/client.js` | Registers one cell into the file tree's `sidebar.right.files.row.actions` seat. The cell is a plain `<a download>` pointing at that route, so the browser's own download manager owns progress, cancellation, and the saved name. |
dsh-plugin-files-download README · What it adds：The file tree is not reimplemented: the seat is declared by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files`, and this package only fills it.

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Requirements：The mounted `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files` client bundle must declare the `sidebar.right.files.row.actions` seat. Stock DSH releases before that seat existed **do not have it** — with such a bundle this plugin's registration fails loudly in the browser-half load report instead of half-rendering. See [Requires the seat](#requires-the-seat) for the one-file-per-package patch.

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Requirements：- DSH version: any build whose `ui-sidebar-files` declares the seat (see above)
- Node: >= 22 (the Host half uses `AbortSignal.any` and WHATWG `ReadableStream`)
- Browser: any modern one; the download is a normal navigation, no client-only APIs

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Install：The package ships prebuilt JavaScript, so installing needs **no build step**.

```sh
dsh-plugin-files-download README · straight from GitHub (pnpm forwards git specs unchanged)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:Yingblock/dsh-plugin-files-download

dsh-plugin-files-download README · or from a checkout / tarball：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-plugin-files-download

Or add the row by hand to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: files-download
      name: dsh-plugin-files-download
```

**Restart `dsh web` afterwards.** The browser's client boot graph is composed at startup, so a running page keeps the graph it loaded with.

Then **hard-refresh the browser** (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). Bundle HMR only applies automatically while `pnpm run dev:web` is running.

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-files-download
```

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Use：1. Open the right Sidebar's **Files** tab.
2. Every file row shows a `↓` control at its right edge, always visible (no hover needed). Directory rows show nothing.
3. Click it — the browser saves the file under its own name.

The control is a real navigation to the Host route, not a page-side fetch, so multi-hundred-MB files stream straight to disk.

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Requires the seat：The `sidebar.right.files.row.actions` seat belongs in the file tree's own package, because the tree owns the row it appears in. It is four small files in `packages/client/ui-sidebar-files`:

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Requires the seat：| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/client/slot-contract.ts` (new) | Declares the seat: `kind: 'single'`, `scope: 'session'`, owner props `{ path, name }` |
| `src/client/index.ts` | The files tab body declares it: `children: { 'sidebar.right.files.row.actions': { kind: 'single', scope: 'session' } }` |
| `src/client/FilesBody.tsx` | Renders it per file row: `renderSlot('sidebar.right.files.row.actions', { path, name })` inside the row |
| `src/client/FilesBody.module.css` | Row becomes `display:flex`; the action container is `flex: 0 0 auto` |

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Requires the seat：Then rebuild that one package:

```sh
tsc -b packages/client/ui-sidebar-files
pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files run bundle
```

Restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh the browser.

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Requires the seat：> **Why `single` and not `keyed`?** A keyed seat dispatches by *registration key* (`entriesOfSlot(key).find(e => e.options.key === entryKey)`), and its key domain is fixed at compile time. The file rows are a runtime set the plugin cannot enumerate, so a constant registration key would never match the tree's per-row dispatch key — the cell stays on the ledger and never renders. One `single` seat rendered once per row, carrying the row's identity in owner props, is the correct shape.

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Verify：Server side — no cookie required to see that the route sits behind authentication:

```sh
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' \
  'http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/workspace-file.download?sessionId=x&path=y'

dsh-plugin-files-download README · Limits：- **Files only.** No directory/zip download.
- **Session scope.** The route resolves the Session's workspace root from the live Session header, falling back to persistence's header-only stat for a cold Session. The GUI's current Session is always live, so this is transparent in normal use.
- **Read authority is `ctx.fs`'s.** A file the composed filesystem can read can be downloaded, including paths outside the workspace — the same authority the built-in preview uses.
- **The saved name is the file's own basename.** Platform-illegal or colliding names are the browser's to handle; this package does not rewrite them.
- **Always visible, by design.** The control does not depend on hover. To make it hover-only, restore `opacity: 0` on `.actions` plus an `.item:hover .actions` rule in the tree's stylesheet.
